visual_philosophy: Build a layered brand world in which live process and heat, product proof, contextual world-building and information systems reinforce one kinetic commercial identity. Photography, display lettering, semantic graphics and tonal contrast operate as one hierarchy rather than independent decorative modules.

stable_grammar.statement: A process/action narrative engine combines visible action, heat/fire/steam/tool interaction and operator credibility while product detail remains legible.
Multiple information tiers carry distinct display, narrative, label and explanatory roles so one headline cannot carry the work alone.
Semantic roles form a directed campaign sequence without requiring equal cards, a fixed module count or fixed module geometry.
Graphic marks are derived from real ingredients, tools, process, place or equivalent brand evidence; the principle is transferable while exact mark assets are not.
A world/context layer uses people, place, origin, service, kitchen or other credible context to expand identity beyond a product advertisement.
Deep low-key fields, warm process highlights, a controlled hot accent and warm light information contrast create high local energy while retaining process and product detail.
Expressive handmade display lettering acts as structural visual mass and interacts with imagery and graphics while functional typography remains subordinate.

variation_axes.allowed_change: Recompose semantic layers freely across the target format.
variation_axes.guardrail: Do not copy the reference's exact three-band layout or fixed card geometry.

variation_axes.allowed_change: Exact hues and accent color may change.
variation_axes.guardrail: Preserve low-key depth, warm process highlights, controlled hot accent and light information contrast as perceptual roles.

variation_axes.allowed_change: People, place, origin, service, kitchen or other credible world evidence may substitute.
variation_axes.guardrail: Context must carry brand-world meaning rather than decorative atmosphere.

content_compatibility.requirement: At least three credible semantic roles: process/action or equivalent live-making evidence; product/ingredient/proof/detail evidence; and world/context evidence.
Equivalent brand-relevant roles may substitute for literal restaurant asset categories.

content_compatibility.risk: A single isolated product image usually supports only a reduced subset and must not be labeled as the full family.

typography_role.display: Expressive handmade lettering is high visual mass integrated with imagery and semantic graphics; it must not collapse into generic oversized brush text.
typography_role.functional: Supporting typography remains subordinate, legible and information-bearing.

typography_program.copy_fidelity_policy: VERBATIM_REQUIRED for all locked brand, dish, price, date, address, slogan, English-name and functional copy; new naming/translation/display content requires human approval.

roles: high local contrast with retained detail
color_light_material_signature.freedom: Exact black, red and ivory values are not invariants.

integration_rules.rule: Process imagery, display lettering, semantic graphics and tonal hierarchy must form one directed first/second/third read.
Every support layer carries a semantic role; decorative filler does not count as campaign depth.
Product/process detail remains legible despite low-key contrast and kinetic heat cues.

generic_shortcut_blockers: Do not collapse to giant generic brush lettering plus one food plate.
Do not copy the exact three-band layout, equal-card geometry or module count.
Do not substitute black/red styling, flames or legacy marks for semantic brand-world structure.
freedoms: new exact palette values within reviewed tonal roles
original lettering shapes consistent with reviewed behavior
